# Build documentation

[Local build and proof](local.md) covers native and shared-library builds, display-independent
unit tests and the GPU window regression. [CI](ci.md) describes platform lanes and
[layout](layout.md) maps the source tree.

- [Local builds](local.md): native requirements and commands.
- [Continuous integration](ci.md): platform toolchains and packaging checks.
- [Source layout](layout.md): the source tree.
- [Store compatibility](store-compatibility.md): supported CLI, IDE, and lake revisions,
  actionable errors, and the independent artifact integration check.
